menu_path_issues: VERSION: strings were read from installed 1.3.2 (build 156), not 1.7.1. Docs are dated ~1 month ago and describe 1.7.x. Labels that exist in 1.3.2 may have changed or been removed in 1.7.1 (the table already admits this for 'Create config'). The RU strings were not checked against the real 1.7.1 App Store build.

'Toggle VPN' / 'Option (⌥) + /': EN docs and the EN key say 'Option (⌥) + /', but the RU value of the long shortcut text says 'Option (⌥) + \' (backslash). Likely a typo in the RU string. Tell RU users 'Option (⌥) + /' only after checking the keyboard on the machine.

Dynamic switch interval: docs say default 30 s; the RU/EN explanatory string says 100 s and calls the field 'Задержка пинга' while the label is 'Интервал пинга'. Do not state a default interval in the answer.

'Language': key exists, but the docs Settings page (iCloud sync, Dynamic switch, Ping, Appearance, Routing, Logs, macOS shortcuts) does not list a Language item, and the app ships 30 lproj folders. Whether it is an in-app picker or opens system language settings is unverified. Tell users to change the app language via system settings unless confirmed.

Zashboard path 'Zashboard dashboard (embedded) > Global | Rule | Direct': the three strings are verbatim in the bundled JS (EN and RU tables), and native keys 'Dashboard'/'Дашборд' and 'Zashboard' exist, but nothing shows how the user opens the dashboard or which language it uses (it has EN, RU, ZH tables). Keep the caveat; native route-level control is Settings > Routing.
Zashboard RU wording differs from native wording: Zashboard 'Logs' tab is 'Журнал', native Settings > Logs is 'Логи'. Do not mix them in one path.

Settings > Routing: the labels 'Исключено'/'Включено' are verbatim, but the explanatory text in the same screen uses 'Исключённые'/'Включённые' and 'Выкл' for Off. Both are valid app text; quote the label forms.

Sort path: docs list three sort options (original order, latency/ping, alphabetical). No 'original order' string was found in ru.lproj (maybe the 'Default' label). The path lists only Alphabetical | Ping; 'Default' as the third sort option is unverified.

Add menu path 'Configs > + (Add config)': docs say 'Use +' and name the ways (QR code, clipboard, URL, YAML file); the exact label of the '+' item and the grouping of the four items under it are not verifiable (closed source). Docs also list a fifth way, the deep link. The claimed URL dialog hint 'Add sub link' vs 'Add via URL' vs 'Add subscription link' are three separate keys with unknown screens.

Delete/rename path 'Configs > config editor > Edit config / Delete config': docs only say the editor lets you rename or delete. 'Edit config' / 'Редактировать конфигурацию' and 'Delete config' / 'Удалить конфигурацию' (plus confirm 'Delete config?') exist, but which is the entry button and which is inside the editor is unverified.

Logs path 'Settings > Logs > Open logs': docs only say Settings has Logs. Log levels exist in strings: Silent/Тихий, Error, Warn, Info, Debug. Key 'If you need logs, select the logging mode in the settings' confirms level is chosen in Settings. Logs are erased after the session ends (string says so), worth adding to the instructions.
First connect path: the string and docs step 2 agree ('allow the app to add a VPN configuration'). 'Set up VPN' screen is unverified; the system dialog itself is macOS text, not app text.
missing_flows: Apple TV transfer (docs: iPhone > configuration editor > Apple TV option): no Apple TV string in macOS ru.lproj; iOS-only, do not offer on macOS.

Filter by protocol: strings 'Displayed protocols' / 'Отображаемые протоколы' and 'DISPLAYED PROTOCOLS' exist (docs: filter by protocol type). Not in the table; separate from 'Select allowed protocols' (dynamic switch only).
Delete/confirm and edit: 'Delete config?', 'Delete', 'Edit', 'Edit config', 'Save', 'Cancel', 'Name'/'Название', 'URL' labels in the add-by-URL dialog are not in the table.
Remote vs local group labels: 'REMOTE GROUP' / 'УДАЛЁННАЯ ГРУППА', 'LOCAL GROUP' / 'ЛОКАЛЬНАЯ ГРУППА', 'Create group', 'Group name'. Add if users ask about adding manual configs.

Proxy mode/Tunneling: native keys 'Mode'/'Режим', 'Tunneling'/'Туннелирование', 'System'/'Системная' exist; their screen and meaning are unverified. Possibly the real native mode switch. Needs a live look in the running app before naming them.
Support button: 'Support'/'Поддержка' (docs: shown only if the provider supplies a support link).
Hidden proxies: 'HIDDEN PROXIES' / 'СКРЫТЫЕ ПРОКСИ' for proxies removed from the list.
Appearance sub-options (docs: light/dark theme, black/white logo, Progress Bar vs Health Bar): specific labels not listed.
Copy/share subscription link, System proxy and TUN toggle: confirmed absent in strings; keep the 'not available' note.
macOS app language: the app ships 30 localizations; add a system-settings route for language if the in-app picker is not confirmed.
caveats: CLOSED SOURCE: no GitHub repo found (gh search, no org). source_available=false. 'file' values are the installed bundle or doc URLs, not source files; there are no file:line evidences and no release tag or commit sha.

MAIN LIMIT: strings come from the macOS app installed on this Mac, /Applications/RabbitHole.app, version 1.3.2 (CFBundleShortVersionString), while the App Store version is 1.7.1 (2026-11-06). Release notes say the interface was redesigned since then; some labels may have changed or been removed (the docs say manual group creation was removed). Re-check with a current build before the assistant quotes any label to users.

The hint labels 'Добавить настройки VPN' and 'Подключиться' were only partly confirmed: 'Подключиться' = Connect verbatim. 'Добавить настройки VPN' does NOT exist in 1.3.2; closest are 'Нажмите, чтобы добавить настройки VPN' and 'Добавить конфигурации VPN'.
EN text: en.lproj has only 5 entries; the English UI text is the key itself (SwiftUI source-language keys), except where en.lproj overrides it (e.g. 'Add subscription link' shows 'Add via URL').
Official docs (GitBook) exist in English only; there is no Russian doc space (ru path 404). RU labels come only from ru.lproj. The docs describe 1.7.x behaviour.
Russian is available: ru.lproj present (292 entries) and App Store lists RU among 28 languages. Not verified whether Language in Settings is an in-app picker or opens system settings.

The app has NO verified 'System proxy' or 'TUN' toggle, no 'Rule/Global/Direct' native switch, no 'share/copy subscription link/QR' and no verified 'update all subscriptions' button. Rule/Global/Direct exist only inside the bundled Zashboard web UI; how to open it is unverified. Do not name these controls to users.

Docs describe app-specific features worth knowing: Apple TV transfer from the config editor, display modes Single/Full (configured by provider headers), Health bar vs Progress bar for traffic, Settings > Appearance, iCloud sync.
Strings with %@ / %lld are runtime templates; what fills 'Connected | %@' was not verified (likely timer or server name).

Screen names ('Configs', 'Settings') come from the docs; on macOS vs iOS layout differences were not observable without running the app (macOS-only: Shortcut, Toggle VPN, Open main window, per-app routing per App Store text). I did not launch the app.
The RU label for 'Log level' is 'Логи' and for 'Ping delay' is 'Интервал пинга' (while its help text says 'Задержка пинга'); quote exactly.
Required OS: App Store reports minimum iOS 17.0; the macOS 15+ hint was not verified.
